title: [PhD] International Relations and Political Science

compensation.value: Full scholarship for the duration of PhD studies
compensation.evidence_quote: Koç University offers all Ph.D. domestic and international admitted students a full scholarship for the duration of their studies.

about: Koç University accepts applications to its PhD in International Relations and Political Science for the spring semester of 2026/27 until 31 December 2026, 23:59:59 Turkey Time. Koç states that all admitted PhD students receive a full scholarship for the duration of their studies.
requirements: Graduate scholarship offers are made automatically to admitted students in eligible thesis programmes; no separate scholarship form
